PERLINDUNGAN PEREMPUAN DAN ANAK DARI TINDAK KEKERASAN DENGAN RAHMAT TUHAN YANG MAHA ESA
translated_text:
CONCERNING
THE PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE BY THE GRACE OF GOD THE ALMIGHTY

REGENT OF MOROWALI,

Considering: a.
b.
c.
d.

Taking into account: 1.
2.

that children and women are creations of God Almighty who constitute important elements of society, and in the future children will become actors in all fields of social and state life;

that Indonesian women have an important role in community activities, development and family life as well as having the obligation to care for, protect and raise Indonesian children to grow and develop as the nation's next generation;

that based on the Provisions in Article 17 paragraph (1) of Law Number 23 of 2014 concerning Regional Government as amended by Law Number 1 of 2022 concerning Financial Relations between the Central Government and Regional Governments, Regions have the right to establish policies for the protection of women and children which constitute mandatory affairs in accordance with their authority;

that based on the considerations as referred to in letter a, letter b, and letter c, it is necessary to establish a Regional Regulation concerning the Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence.

CHAPTER I
GENERAL PROVISIONS
Article I
In this Regional Regulation, what is meant by:
1. Child is a person who has not yet reached 18 years of age, including a child in the womb.
2. Woman is an adult human being of female sex and a person who is legally recognized as a woman.
3. Protection is all service actions to fulfill rights, as well as guarantee and protect the rights of victims of acts of violence.
4. Child protection is all activities to guarantee and protect children and their rights so that they can live, grow, develop, and participate optimally in accordance with human dignity and worth, as well as receive protection from violence and discrimination.
5. Protection of women is an effort aimed at protecting women and their rights in order to obtain a sense of security from acts of violence.
6. Violence is any act that results in or causes suffering and distress whether physical, sexual, psychological including neglect, threats of certain actions, coercion or arbitrary deprivation of freedom, whether occurring in public or in private life.
7. Physical violence is any act that causes pain, injury, wounds or disability to a person's body, miscarriage or unconsciousness and/or causes death.
8. Psychological violence is an act that results in fear, loss of self-confidence, loss of ability to act, disbelief or severe psychological suffering in a person.
9. Victims of acts of violence hereinafter referred to as victims are individuals or groups of people who experience suffering whether physical, mental or emotional, economic loss, or experience neglect, reduction or deprivation of their basic rights, as a result of human rights (HAM) violations, or criminal acts as well as acts of violence committed either by state apparatus or by individuals.
10. Regional Technical Service Unit for the Protection of Women and Children hereinafter abbreviated as UPTD PPA is a regional technical implementing unit, established by the regional government in providing services for women and children who experience violence, discrimination, special protection and other problems.
11. Coordination Forum for the Protection of Victims of Violence hereinafter abbreviated as FKPKK is a coordination forum for handling victims of violence against women and children whose implementation is carried out in a networked and collaborative manner.
12. Region is Morowali Regency.
13. Regional Apparatus is an auxiliary element of the Regent in the administration of Government affairs that are the authority of the Region.
14. Regional Government is the Government of Morowali Regency.
15. Regional Governance is the administration of government affairs by the Government and DPRD according to the principles of autonomy and assistance tasks with the principle of the widest possible autonomy in the system and principles of the Unitary State of the Republic of Indonesia as referred to in the 1945 Constitution of the Republic of Indonesia.
16. Regent is the Regent of Morowali.
17. Office of Village Community Empowerment, Women's Empowerment and Child Protection hereinafter abbreviated as Dinas PMDP3A is the regional apparatus of Morowali Regency that carries out government affairs in the field of women and children.

FORMS OF VIOLENCE
Article 3
Forms of Violence include:
a. physical violence;
b. psychological violence;
c. sexual violence; and/or
d. domestic neglect.

translated_text:
Article 4
Physical violence as referred to in Article 3 letter a results in: a. the victim experiencing pain or serious injury;
b. the death of the victim; and
c. causing illness or impediment to carrying out occupational duties or livelihood or daily activities.

Article 10
(1) Safe houses as referred to in Article 9 paragraph (1) provide temporary shelter and/or accommodation for victims of Violence until their rights are restored.

translated_text:
Article 12
(1) Regional Government is obligated to:
a. implement the policy for protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence established by the government;
b. establish policies, programs, and activities for protection of Women and Children from acts of violence; and
c. conduct cooperation with law enforcement apparatus, government apparatus, as well as educational institutions, health institutions, hospitals, and various Non-Governmental Organizations concerned with Women and Children in the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence.
(2) Regional Government is responsible for:
a. providing support for facilities and infrastructure for the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence; and b. allocating budget for the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence in accordance with the financial capacity of the Region. (3) In the case of implementation of the obligations of Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (1) and implementation of the responsibilities of Regional Government as referred to in paragraph (2), Regional Government shall prepare a Regional Action Plan for protection of victims. (4) The Regional Action Plan as referred to in paragraph (3) constitutes part of the Medium-Term Development Plan.

(2) The service for repatriation and social reintegration as referred to in Article 17 paragraph (1) letter d aims to return victims to be accepted back into their social environment.
(3) The service for repatriation and social reintegration of victims is carried out after the implementation of socialization related to the rights of Women and Children as victims of violence.

BAB VII
PEMBERDAYAAN
Pasal 28

CHAPTER VII
EMPOWERMENT
Article 28
Forms of empowerment for Women victims of Violence include: a. job training;
b. productive economic enterprises and joint business families; and c. capital assistance.

KERJASAMA
Pasal 29
(1) Datam rangka mencapai tujuan perlindungan hak Perempuan dari tindak Kekerasan Pemerintah Daerah bekerja sama dengan :
a. Pemerintah Daerah lain; dan
b. kmbaga non pemerintah.
(21 Ker;,a sama sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi: a. perhrkaran data dan informasi;

c. pemulangan dan reintegrasi sosial; dan

translated_text:
CHAPTER VIII
COOPERATION
Article 29
(1) In order to achieve the objective of protecting the rights of Women from acts of Violence, the Regional Government cooperates with:
a. other Regional Governments; and
b. non-governmental institutions.
(2) Cooperation as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. exchange of data and information;
b. rehabilitation of victims of acts of Violence;
c. repatriation and social reintegration; and
d. provision of evidence and witnesses which shall be followed up in accordance with applicable law.

text:
BAB IX
PEMBINAAN DAN PENGAWASAN
Pasal 3O
(1) Pemerintah Daerah berkewajiban melakukan pembinaan dan pengawasan penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dan tindak Kekerasan.
(2) Pembinaan dan Pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (1) meliputi:
a. koordinasi;
b. bimbingan;
c. pendidikan dan pelatihan; dan
d. pemantauan dan evaluasi.
(3) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud ayat (2) dalam rangka mewujudkan tujuan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak dari tindak Kekerasan sesuai standar pelayanan minimal yang dilaksanakan Dinas PMDPSA dan masyarakat.
(4) Pembinaan dan pengawasan sebagaimana dimaksud pada ayat (3) dilakukan dengan prinsip profesional dan tranparan.
(5) Dinas PMDP3A wajib melaporkan secara berkala kepada Bupati mengenai penyelenggaraan perlindungan Perempuan dan Anak korban Kekerasan.
translated_text:
CHAPTER IX
GUIDANCE AND SUPERVISION
Article 30
(1) The Regional Government is obligated to conduct guidance and supervision of the implementation of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence.
(2) Guidance and Supervision as referred to in paragraph (1) includes:
a. coordination;
b. guidance;
c. education and training; and
d. monitoring and evaluation.
(3) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (2) is in order to realize the objectives of protection of Women and Children from acts of Violence in accordance with minimum service standards implemented by the PMDPSA Office and the community.
(4) Guidance and supervision as referred to in paragraph (3) shall be conducted with professional and transparent principles.
(5) The PMDP3A Office is obligated to report periodically to the Regent regarding the implementation of protection of Women and Children victims of Violence.

text:

Pasal 31

a. Anggaran Pendapatan dan Belanja Daerah; dan
b. penerimaan lain yang sah sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan yang berlaku.
translated_text:
BAB X

Article 31
The costs of activities related to the implementation of protection for Women and Children shall be charged to:
a. Regional Revenue and Expenditure Budget; and

Article 32

OF
REGIONAL REGULATION OF MOROWALI REGENCY
NUMBER YEAR 2022
CONCERNING
PROTECTION OF WOMEN AND CHILDREN
FROM ACTS OF VIOLENCE

I. GENERAL

Protection from violence that threatens the safety and health of women and children must be provided from an early stage. Protection is necessary to prevent violence and physical, mental and sexual exploitation. For example, women and children victims of abuse, neglect, eviction and maltreatment by parents or other people. For women and children experiencing these problems, the government must provide Safe Houses and adequate budget, the role of various parties to help handle violence problems faced by children and women including social community organizations, volunteers, social workers, medical personnel, advocates and religious leaders.

The condition of the deterioration of children along with their rights and the condition of violence against children and women that frequently occurs in the region should become a common concern for all stakeholders including regional governments to play a role in preventing and overcoming such deterioration and violence.

For the regional government of Morowali Regency in facing the universe of conditions above, various actions are taken to fulfill children's rights as well as prevent and assist in handling acts of violence against children and women which is endeavored by establishing a Regional Regulation concerning Protection of Women and Children From Acts of Violence.
